description: S45 T5 (PM7.1): proposal.get answers the row exactly as proposal.list renders it (same ProposalRow shape, command spelling included) PLUS `digest` — the sha256 of the canonical payload, the token proposal.commit must carry back — and `preview`, the ADVISORY before-you-commit answer (S37 AA4: the commit re-validates and re-reads, never trusting this). For an mcp_server_add row the preview is null: the kind names no policy target, and inventing one would be the preview guessing. A read writes nothing anywhere.
